case: Sage green T-shirt with one small botanical center-chest print

prompts.direct_atlas: Edit this exact square UV atlas into a flat base-color texture. Keep canvas, UV island positions and scale unchanged. Fill the entire atlas including gutters with sage green #87977C. Lower right deep-neck panel is front, lower left is back, upper curved panels are sleeves, thin rectangles are trims. Put only one dark-green olive branch near (765,560), approximately 90×135px in a 1024 square. Back/sleeves plain. Remove all guide outlines. No shading, grain, shadows, labels, seam lines, folds or garment photographs.
prompts.graphic: One upright slender olive branch with 8–12 narrow leaves and two fruits, forest-green #263B28 ink only, on genuinely transparent background. Premium small chest print, centered, thin clean botanical strokes. No paper, lettering, shadows, garment, UV atlas or mockup.

mapping.fabric_channel: TEXCOORD_1 / Blender UVMap.001; do not use for artwork
mapping.render_conversion: SVG viewBox is 0 -1 1 1. The successful Blender render uses UVMap with V mapped to 1-V via texture transform. Export retains this transform. Do not assume this transform is universal: calibrate each model/browser texture upload convention.
mapping.geometry: Garment geometry unchanged; hidden helper Cube removed only from experimental rendering/export.

results.direct_atlas: After V conversion, botanical graphic renders upright on front, back remains blank. Model invented baked shading and changed print size; narrow UV strip boundaries not retained. Suitable as experimental appearance, not reliable exact atlas output.
results.composed: Generated transparent graphic composited at exact front coordinate over constant-color atlas. Front upright; back/sleeves blank. Left/right/cover/back rendered. Browser loads both embedded-texture GLBs interactively. Uniform-color gutters prevent white bleed for this case.
results.render_note: Existing normal-map shoulder artifacts remain in both variants and are not texture-generation defects.

recommended_pipeline: Chat extracts editable design plan: baseColor, artwork prompt, target panel, size, position
AI generates graphics or seamless tile assets
Local renderer maps assets onto validated UV panels with correct channel/orientation and gutters
Apply texture to model; preserve normal/roughness
Capture 3D preview into chat; keep design layers for iterative edits
limits: One garment and one small print tested. Full-body repeats, exact text/logos and cross-seam continuous artwork not validated.
Browser comparison is a local experiment; production generation endpoint remains unchanged during this experiment.
Initial uncalibrated render attempts are retained in intermediate folders for audit.
